items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So we went into rehearsal, and the first thing, trouble was that we had to play off the stage. So, of course, we had Marlon -- ... So Jessica Tandy protested.

ctx.x: So they come up with Johnny Mehegan. So now we -- we got a trumpet, clarinet, drums and piano. So we go into rehearsal for the show. Now, the -- so now, Maheema Nigrel was the musical director. He didn't know anything about jazz or what it was supposed to do, says, Barefield, it's up to you.

All right. So we started picking tunes and putting the tunes together for this Streetcar Named Desire. Then with, you know, with Marlon Brando and Jessica Tandy and all. So we went into rehearsal, and the first thing, trouble was that we had to play off the stage. So, of course, we had Marlon --
an organist, you know, played the harpsichord. Only he played from the stage. Good friend of mine -- I can't think of his name right now. He died -- Marlon -- well, I'll think of it.
